So right now I don’t know what to do because I put my hope on this  app  thinking I was going to be ready for this upcoming exam now I’m just loss. I’m willing to change my review if this issue is fixed. I’m still hoping this can be resolved soon , I just need to access my recordings and the features that were promised.
